review_basis: Final encoded atlas reviewed at native and enlarged sizes. Facial direction landmarks are unchanged; the chin border is confined to its curve and the original embedded fringe upper-eye remnant is removed. Fresh independent blind verdicts are recorded in qa/blind-jaw-*.json.
alpha_review: Transparent rows reported near y=176-184 are the open spaces between the separate legs below the body, continuous with the outside background. The face, hair and body surfaces have no accidental holes: when a side-hair lock swings outward, the cheek it uncovers is filled with a face-skin copy shifted outward (so the cheek continues in skin colour) and the crown/temple seam with a static hair copy; both underlays are switched off when the lock swings inward so no colour shows outside the outline.
